description: AuthConfig::is_operator does a direct string equality check (u == username) against operator_usernames. Usernames derived from OIDC claims (email, sub) are not normalized to lowercase at the point they are checked against the operator list. If an operator configures operator_usernames = ["Admin@example.com"] but the OIDC token produces username = "admin@example.com" (lowercased by some IdPs), the check fails. Conversely, CredentialStore normalizes usernames to ASCII-lowercase at load time; there is an inconsistency between the two code paths. Fix: normalize to ASCII-lowercase in is_operator or at the point the username is extracted from the OIDC claim.
title: auth: is_operator comparison is case-sensitive; operator_usernames from OIDC may have mixed case
